description: This file defines the LeaveAssignmentService class responsible for handling leave assignment logic within the OrangeHRM system. It manages assigning leave requests, validating leave periods, checking for overlaps and work shift limits, saving leave requests, and dispatching events related to leave assignment.

classes.name: LeaveAssignmentService
classes.description: Service class handling the logic for assigning leave to employees. It manages validating leave periods, overlapping leaves, work shift limits, saving leave requests, and dispatching related events.

methods.name: assignLeave
methods.description: Main method to assign leave based on provided leave parameters. Validates date range, overlaps, and work shift limits before saving leave request.

methods.name: saveLeaveRequest
methods.description: Handles the process of creating and saving a leave request, including checking entitlements, comments, and triggering leave assignment events.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestStatus
methods.description: Determines the status of a leave request based on the date and leave type, considering weekends, holidays, and workflow state.

methods.name: allowToExceedLeaveBalance
methods.description: Indicates whether the employee is allowed to exceed their leave balance (returns true).

methods.name: getWorkflowItemForAssignAction
methods.description: Retrieves the workflow state machine item that corresponds to the 'ASSIGN' action for leave, caching the result for subsequent calls.
